---
name: News correction request
about: Report a potential factual error or misleading claim in a First Light episode
title: "Correction request: "
labels: []
assignees: []
---

## Episode and approximate timestamp
Provide the episode date (YYYY-MM-DD) and approximate audio timestamp.

## Statement to review
Quote or paraphrase the potentially inaccurate or misleading statement.

## Supporting original source
Link to a reliable publisher report, official record or other relevant evidence.
Please include its publication date if possible.

## Requested clarification
Explain whether the claim needs a correction, qualification, attribution or
better source context.

## Privacy
Do not include private personal data, credentials or confidential information.

---
This issue is a request for human editorial review. Filing it does not prove
the claim is wrong, nor does an automated source audit establish factual truth.
